Bernie's Besties

Program Overview

Receive a commission when you refer a new customer to Bernie's Best. Level up the commissions you receive based on the number of orders you've referred (see details below on levels).

Provide those customers 20% off their first order when they shop at Bernies.com using your unique discount code or via your affiliate link.

Please note that receiving payments requires a free PayPal account. Payouts are initiated after the 21-day return period for orders has elapsed. Payments are processed on Mondays and Thursdays each week.

Level 1 - $15/new customer
Level 2 - 5 Orders, $15/new customer, 3% of sales
Level 3 - 25 Orders, $17/new customer, 3% of sales
Level 4 - 100 Orders, $17/new customer, 5% of sales
Level 5 - 250 Orders, $19/new customer, 5% of sales
Level 6 - 500 Orders, $20/new customer, 5% of sales
Level 7 - 1000 Orders, $21/new customer, 5% of sales

Created to Give Bernie the Best

Nothing Else Was Good Enough, So We Created Perfect Poop for Bernie

When we couldn’t find a digestive supplement that truly met the needs of our dog, Bernie, we decided to create our own.

It was really embarrassing for us and Bernie when we had to wipe watery poop off his fluffy butt fur, and even worse, throwing out all those rugs that were unsalvageable.

We were tired of the cost and hassle of juggling multiple supplements and opening countless bottles at every meal.

Many products were messy powders that stuck to the bowl, leaving much of it uneaten and wasted. This frustration sparked our mission to make something better for Bernie.

We sought out the best natural ingredients, backed by research, and then partnered with Ph.D. veterinary science researchers, formulation experts, and ingredient specialists. And that’s how our first product, Perfect Poop, was born.

We Couldn’t Stop There

After witnessing the incredible impact Perfect Poop had on thousands of dogs, we knew we couldn’t stop at just one product.

We realized we could offer a wide range of better solutions than what was available on the market. This inspired us to create a full range of products designed to benefit all dogs including our own.

So, we expanded our team and continue to develop products that, like Perfect Poop, are built on cutting-edge research and stand out from the rest. We’re proud of what we’ve created and confident that our products will bring healthier, happier lives to your dogs—just as they have for ours.

Dedicated to Supporting Healthy Dogs & Happy Lives

Life feels more complete with dogs as members of the family. Dogs are just amazing and we consider them to be an important and essential part of a well-lived life. We have a passion for these furry companions and are dedicated to helping them enjoy the healthiest, happiest, and longest lives possible.

That’s why every member of our team feels so inspired each day as we research, develop, and test new and better products for the dogs we love so much. We also feel energized when we get to help and support our fellow pet parents and their families.

All of us in the Bernie’s Best team are committed to developing products that enhance dog’s lives and make life more fun and a little easier for pet parents.

Bernie’s Besties Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Bernie’s Besties—our Affiliate Program.

These Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) apply to all individuals or entities (“Affiliate,” “you”) who participate in the Program to promote products offered by Bernie’s (“Merchant,” “we,” “us”).

By registering for and participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, you may not participate in the Program.

1. Enrollment and Acceptance

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate application at our sole discretion.

You acknowledge that you have no legal recourse regarding the acceptance or rejection of your application.

2. Affiliate Links, Attribution, and Coupons

Affiliates will be provided with a unique referral link and may generate links to specific products or collections.

Attribution is based on the most recent referral link clicked prior to purchase.

Some Affiliates may be assigned a unique coupon code, as outlined in their dashboard. If both a referral link and coupon code are used in a single transaction, only one commission will be awarded.

Affiliates may only promote coupon codes that have been explicitly assigned to them. Promotion of unauthorized, leaked, or publicly sourced coupon codes is prohibited.

3. Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn commissions on qualifying purchases made through their referral link or assigned coupon code.

Commission amounts are based on order value and exclude taxes, shipping, and additional fees.

To receive payment, Affiliates must provide accurate and complete payment details in their account settings.

Payout schedules are outlined in the Affiliate Guide and may be updated from time to time.

We reserve the right to review all transactions for validity. Commissions will not be paid on orders that are canceled, refunded, flagged as fraudulent, or result in chargebacks.

We reserve the right to withhold or reverse commissions in cases of suspected fraud, abuse, or violation of these Terms.

4. Marketing Materials and Brand Use

We may provide promotional assets (e.g., logos, banners, product images, and copy) for Affiliate use.

Affiliates may only use approved brand assets and must not modify logos, trademarks, or messaging in a way that misrepresents Bernie’s brand.

All promotions must accurately reflect the product and must not include false, misleading, or unsubstantiated claims.

5. Content License and Usage Rights

By participating in the Program, you grant Bernie’s a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, transferable license to use, reproduce, edit, modify, adapt, publish, translate, distribute, and display any content you create that features or promotes Bernie’s products or your affiliate code.

This includes, but is not limited to:

  • Images

  • Videos

  • Social media posts

  • Ad creative

  • Written content

You agree that Bernie’s may use this content for marketing, advertising, and promotional purposes across any channel without additional compensation or approval.

6. Permitted Promotion Channels

Affiliates may promote Bernie’s products through approved online and offline channels, including websites, email, social media, and print.

Affiliates are solely responsible for ensuring that their promotional methods comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and platform policies.

7. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates may not:

  • Make false, misleading, or unverified claims about Bernie’s products

  • Misrepresent their relationship with Bernie’s

  • Use spam, unsolicited messaging, or deceptive marketing practices

  • Bid on Bernie’s branded keywords (e.g., “Bernie’s Best”) in paid advertising without prior written approval

  • Impersonate Bernie’s brand or create confusingly similar websites, domains, or social accounts

  • Promote unauthorized or unassigned coupon codes

  • Engage in fraudulent activity, including self-referrals or manipulation of tracking systems

  • Referrals via ads (e.g., Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) are prohibited.

8. Restricted Content and Placement

Affiliates may not promote Bernie’s products or links on websites, platforms, or content that:

  • Promote or contain violence

  • Are sexual, explicit, or pornographic in nature

  • Promote hate speech, discrimination, or harassment

  • Involve illegal activities

  • Contain misleading, defamatory, or harmful content

  • Violate intellectual property rights

We reserve the right to determine, at our sole discretion, whether any content or platform is inappropriate.

9. FTC Disclosure and Compliance

Affiliates must clearly and conspicuously disclose their relationship with Bernie’s in all promotions, in accordance with applicable laws and FTC guidelines (e.g., using “#ad” or “#affiliate”).

10. Network / Downline Commissions (If Enabled)

If the Network feature is enabled, Affiliates may refer others to join the Program using a unique referral link.

Affiliates may earn additional commissions from qualifying purchases generated by referred Affiliates (“downline”), as defined in program settings.

We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or terminate network commission structures at any time.

11. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to track referrals. If a customer disables or clears cookies, tracking may not be possible, and commissions may not be awarded.

Cookie duration is specified during Affiliate registration.

The tracking window begins when a customer clicks an Affiliate link or uses an assigned coupon code. During this period, qualifying purchases may be attributed to the Affiliate without requiring additional clicks.

12. Termination and Removal

Affiliates may request removal from the Program at any time by contacting besties@bernies.com.

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any Affiliate account at our discretion, including for violations of these Terms.

13. Program Modifications

We reserve the right to update or modify these Terms, commission structures, or any aspect of the Affiliate Program at any time.

Continued participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of any changes.

14. Limitation of Liability

Bernie’s shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the Affiliate Program.

15. Contact

If you have any questions regarding the Affiliate Program, please contact:

besties@bernies.com

Go Forward and Refer!

We’re glad you’re here and excited to have you as part of Bernie’s Besties.
